# Phylogenetic fixed-prior fit fixture

This synthetic data set was generated by a standalone dense-Gaussian script written for this task on 2026-11-15, independently of the package engines. The supplemental fit experiment was generated after preliminary package comparisons. It is not a pre-comparison freeze or a recovery study. The project code and this newly generated fixture are provided under the repository license.

The generator was authored by a Codex subagent and reviewed against independent dense score and curvature calculations; it imports no drmTMB or DRModels.jl source. The generator used seed 17822 and Mersenne-Twister/Inversion/Rejection. Its author reported R 4.6.0 and jsonlite 2.0.0, but the original run did not retain an environment receipt. The subsequent portable replay environment is recorded in `replay-environment.txt.gz`. The generator SHA-256 is `d82187ffa13050dc3d5d9738f4da1d5b0284416954b88cfd0595d442f138e1f2`; the original frozen JSON SHA-256 is `cad7474b2aaf30c8132dd8ecb1473117b589fbd8dd22d443f8c66d28f43235a1`. The generated CSV SHA-256 is `9e074698e036b09dc36834d58d3c2618dc04932ccda2863c5073f9ec03d1d4f8`. The portable `generator.R` differs from the original only in its output-path handling; its SHA-256 is `79bc05cdd1b01504742936012231f44f93266d86a57bd6079e20ef5ae163180b`. The portable generator reproduced the recorded JSON within 1e-12. The separate `independent-fit-objective-audit.R` checks the saved fit using objective-only finite differences; its output is retained in `independent-fit-objective-audit.log.gz`. The portable replay used macOS Accelerate BLAS.

Six parameters are ordered as mean intercept and slope, log residual-SD intercept and slope, then log phylogenetic-SD intercept and slope. Normal priors are `N(0.1, 0.7^2)` for the mean slope and `N(-0.2, 0.5^2)` for the residual-SD slope. Four starts reached the same objective, 104.69371002665, and the final score maximum was 1.07e-13. The minimum Hessian eigenvalue was 3.70295 and its condition number was 39.36. This does not establish interval calibration or general recovery.

The independent fit audit source SHA-256 is `7dae9580be4d611f1d4eac3d7c78992ad9b24b31ec75ccae3db2529e4fac43c9`. It is a separate Codex-agent calculation performed after the preliminary package comparisons.
